Reviewer: skull pool job review-4380, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. This is the first review of this PR.

Requested before merge:

1. **Class: a field has no generator effect. Disable the choice for Auto with a Tap tool.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:318` checks only the stated cycle. On a mill, use a Drill with a Tap tool, Auto, a through hole, and no Bottom override. The combo stays enabled. `drilling::auto_kind` selects Tap, and `drill_point_length` adds no point for that tool. Thus the choice has no effect. Use the generator's tool/cycle rule to disable every choice that cannot change the tip run. Add UI tests for Auto with a Tap and for a flat-bottom Drill. A Bore tool on Auto and a flat-bottom Drill have the same gap.
2. **Class: a refusal hides missing output coverage. Record LinuxCNC drilling output.** `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/linuxcnc/drill_full_diameter.refusal:2` checks only the missing safe-retract warning. It does not check the full-diameter depth. I changed the stream depth from -12.803 to -11.000. `script_linuxcnc::drill_full_diameter` still passed. Add a case with valid machine or retract settings. Record its NC output and check Z-12.803. Keep the missing-machine check separate. Require an NC golden with the expected depth for each post that supports this drilling cycle. Item 5 of #2528 needs drilling output for this supported post.
3. **Class: UI evidence lacks a matched comparison. Add before/after screenshots.** The PR body's Screenshots table shows two states of the new UI. It shows no image of the old UI. The change at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:84` needs a before/after pair with the same tool, cycle, and hole list. Put the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

`cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-post -- -D warnings` passed.

Light lane: all 11 twins passed across five targets. There were 0 failures and 0 stalls (22.1 minutes). I ran `cargo xtask gate light --only "motion light:" --only "app light:"`. Each selected target built in release mode. The targets were:

Extra suites run:

After the quick gate, I ran these fixture consumers explicitly. The 29 post suites passed 440 tests. The four app suites passed 52 tests, with four ignored.

The catalog suites also ran again by name:

Safety checks and mutations:

This review uses the safety tier because the PR moves stock-simulation code and adds NC fixtures. I compared the moved code with its preimage. The differences are module headers, imports, and the required visibility changes. I read all 27 new goldens line by line. No existing NC golden changed.

- Change the Fanuc golden depth to Z-11: `script_fanuc::drill_full_diameter` failed (exit 101). Restore it: passed (exit 0).
- Remove the point allowance from the recorded stream: `recorded_post_streams::drill_full_diameter_stream_is_current` failed (exit 101). Restore it: passed (exit 0).
- With the altered stream, `script_linuxcnc::drill_full_diameter` passed (exit 0). This confirms finding 2.

These mutations changed fixture data only. The fixtures are restored, and the worktree is clean. No PR code was changed or pushed. Full heavy lanes are not required for this P7 review and were not run here.

Non-blocking size note: `operation/generate.rs` and `tests/break_through.rs` are already above the 400-line target. They grow by two and three lines.

I did not change the draft state, labels, or title. The PR is now marked ready. The review worktree and its target remain for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Role: reviewer
Owner: mkinney / skull pool job review-4380
Final head: 31438caa177248f38170a791af6c0a8957e33c66
Result: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4380#issuecomment-7226134531 (three findings; needs-rework is recommended; labels are unchanged)

Addressed: the three findings of the review https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4380#issuecomment-7226134531 (reviewed head 31438caa1).

New head: `2acc52c3e2d831b2be32e414c078393c713f90be`. The author's commits are kept. There is no rebase and no force-push.

1. **A field has no generator effect (Break-through from).** Commit 15626f333.
   - The page now asks the generator's own rule for the selected tool and cycle: `drilling::through_tip_run` from the full diameter, with no allowance. A zero point disables the choice and shows the reason on hover. One rule closes the class: Auto with a tap, a boring bar or an end mill, and a 180 degree drill.
   - An unknown tool or a refused tip angle keeps the choice live, because there the choice can change the result.
   - The document cannot hold a 180 degree Drill (the tool check refuses it). Thus the page test uses the seeded flat end mill as the flat-bottom tool. The unit test covers the 180 degree drill on Auto, Drill and Peck.
   - Pins: `holes_break_through::drill_break_through_from_is_idle_for_a_tool_without_a_point` and `holes_break_through::drill_break_through_from_page_disables_a_tap_and_a_flat_drill_on_auto`.
   - Mutation: with the tool rule disabled, both tests fail. With the rule restored, both pass.
2. **A refusal hides missing output coverage (LinuxCNC).** Commit 2acc52c3e.
   - LinuxCNC now also posts `drill_full_diameter` on `assets/machines/vmc.mch`, which states a safe retract. The NC golden `linuxcnc/drill_full_diameter_on_machine.nc` records `G73 X20 Y10 Z-12.803 R1 Q4 F60`. The machine-less refusal check stays separate.
   - Class guard: `recorded_streams::each_drilling_post_records_the_full_diameter_depth`. Each post with a mill drilling cycle must have an NC golden of this case with 12.803 (plain or `_on_machine`). The posts with no mill drilling cycle are an explicit list (`recorded::NO_MILL_DRILL_CYCLE`).
   - Heidenhain Klartext is a named gap (`recorded::DRILL_DEPTH_GAP`). On its profiled machine (`fehlmann-picomax55.mch`), it stops with "unsupported milling tool kind (unstated)", because the recorded stream states no tool kind. I filed #4461 for it.
   - Pins: `script_linuxcnc::drill_full_diameter_on_a_machine_posts_the_full_diameter_depth` and the guard above.
   - Mutation: the stream depth changed from Z -12803 to -11000 makes the LinuxCNC machine test fail. A hidden machine golden makes the guard fail. With the data restored, both pass.
3. **UI evidence lacks a matched comparison.** The PR body now has before (`upstream/main`) and after (this PR) pairs. Each pair has the same tool, the same cycle (Auto), the same hole list (one through hole) and the same pointer position. The pairs are for TAP-M6 and DR-0400. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at the fixed commit 77e36f49c.

Gate on the new head:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (clean target, `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1`): 393 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 40.3 min.
- The UI lib has 1763 passed and 8 ignored. `script_linuxcnc` has 13 passed. `recorded_streams` has 13 passed. `example_catalog` has 44 passed and 4 ignored.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-post -- -D warnings`: clean.
- I did not run the heavy lanes. This round changes UI code and post tests only, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" requires no heavy step for a P7 PR.

The PR keeps its ready flag. AGENTS.md (#3727) says that a review finding does not make a PR a draft again. The new head waits for a fresh review. Please re-review.

Reviewer: MacBook-Pro pool job review-4380-r2, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. This is a re-review of the new head after https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4380#issuecomment-7229834065.

The three earlier findings are fixed. The PR head is green alone. But the trial merge with the current `upstream/main` has two red tests. Both come from main commits that merged after this head. A merge of `upstream/main` into the branch, two regenerated goldens and one test fix close them.

## Earlier findings (review https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4380#issuecomment-7226134531)

1. **Break-through from is live where it has no effect: fixed** (commit 15626f333).
   - `holes_page::break_through_from_idle` now asks `drilling::through_tip_run(tool, cycle, 0.0, FullDiameter)`. This is the same call that the generator makes with the operation's tool and cycle (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3131`). Thus the UI rule and the generator cannot disagree.
   - A Tap, a boring bar, an end mill on Auto, and a 180 degree drill give a zero point and disable the choice. An unknown tool or a refused tip angle keeps it live.
   - `drill_break_through_from_is_idle_for_a_tool_without_a_point` and `drill_break_through_from_page_disables_a_tap_and_a_flat_drill_on_auto` pass on the trial merge.
2. **The LinuxCNC refusal hides the depth: fixed** (commit 2acc52c3e).
   - `linuxcnc/drill_full_diameter_on_machine.nc` records `G73 X20 Y10 Z-12.803 R1 Q4 F60` on `vmc.mch`. I read the golden line by line. The safe retract `G53 G0 Z0`, the `G99` R-plane return and the depth are correct.
   - The guard `recorded_streams::each_drilling_post_records_the_full_diameter_depth` closes the class. Klartext is a named gap with the open follow-up #4461.
3. **No matched before/after screenshots: fixed.** The body has two pairs (TAP-M6 and DR-0400, Auto, one through hole). The four PNGs are on the fork commit `77e36f49c` under `4380/`, not in the PR tree.

## Requested before merge

1. **NEW blocker (from newer main): two new post goldens are stale.** On the trial merge, `script_goldens` has 467 passed and 2 failed:
   - `script_fanuc::drill_full_diameter`
   - `script_doosan_dnm::drill_full_diameter`

   Cause: PR #4382 (commit 129ebbe6e, "state G17 and G94 in the Fanuc and Doosan DNM preambles") merged after this head. The posts now write `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80`. The PR's goldens have `G90 G54 G40 G49 G80` (Fanuc) and `G90 G17 G54 G40 G49 G80` (Doosan DNM). The drilling line `G73 X20. Y10. Z-12.803 R1. Q4. F60.` is the same in the output and in the golden.

   ```text
   assertion `left == right` failed: golden .../crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/fanuc/drill_full_diameter.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 and read the diff
   assertion `left == right` failed: golden .../crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/doosan-dnm/drill_full_diameter.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 and read the diff
   ```

   Fix: merge `upstream/main` into the branch (no rebase). Regenerate the two goldens with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`. Make sure that only the preamble line changes. These goldens are new in this PR, so "Goldens moved: None" can stay. Name the two regenerated files in the body.

2. **NEW blocker (from newer main): one UI test fails after the merge.** `holes_break_through::drill_break_through_from_is_disabled_where_it_has_no_effect` fails at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/holes_break_through.rs:215`. The hover over the enabled row paints no text with "adds the drill point cone". The same test passes on the bare PR head (6 of 6 `holes_break_through` tests pass there).

   Probable cause: commit cf3565107 ("every input on the operation pages has an accessible name") merged after this head. `form::prop_row` now gives the row's controls the row label as their accessible name (`named_by`). `form::hint` attaches the tooltip to the label response only (`remember(lab)`). The test hovers the centre of `get_by_label("Break-through from")`. After the merge, that point probably is not on the label, so no tooltip shows. The disabled-row hover still works, because it rides the whole row (`row.response.on_disabled_hover_text`).

   Fix: after the merge, hover the label node itself (for example, select the node with the label role, or the left part of the row). Keep the assertion on the painted hint. Do not remove or ignore the assertion (AGENTS.md "A UI refit PR keeps its tests": the `#[test]` count and the asserts stay).

## Results (local, on MacBook-Pro, no runner)

- PR head: `2acc52c3e2d831b2be32e414c078393c713f90be`.
- Base: `upstream/main` at `b6089ea6e82c0bc47ebb6cf7343b5956684e1126`.
- Trial merge: `8286c144399f9457bff65ea0b01aa2bb6bd5286f`. Its first parent is the PR head. Local `git merge` (ort, with rename detection) has no conflicts. `git merge-tree` against `b6089ea6e` and against GitHub's base `7da53e2a0` is also clean. GitHub still reports `CONFLICTING`. A merge of `upstream/main` into the branch also removes that state.

| Step (trial merge) | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post --test script_goldens` | 467 passed, **2 failed** (Requested 1) |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 1808 passed, **1 failed** (Requested 2), 8 ignored |
| `camcraft-ui --lib holes_break_through` on the bare PR head | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-motion --lib` | 769 passed, 22 ignored |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 329 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test break_through` | 12 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test recorded_post_streams` | 6 passed |
| `clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-post -- -D warnings` | clean |

I did not run the full quick plan (261 steps). The two blockers are enough for this verdict. The author's quick gate on the PR head (393 steps, 0 failed) does not include the newer main.

Extra suites run:

- `camcraft-app`: `example_catalog` (50 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1 passed), `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed).
- `camcraft-post`: `script_goldens` (the 27 post suites and `recorded_streams`), as above.
- No file under `testdata/` and no importer code changes. Thus the kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Heavy lanes: not run. The diff since the earlier review changes UI code and post tests only. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" requires no heavy step for a P7 PR. The author's heavy record on `31438caa1` (115 steps, 0 new failures) is for an older head.

## Safety tier and mutations

This review uses the safety tier: the PR adds NC goldens and moves stock-simulation code. I restored each mutation, and the suites were green again after the restore (38 passed).

- The stream depth `Z -12803` changed to `Z -11000` in `streams/drill_full_diameter.cnc`: `script_linuxcnc::drill_full_diameter_on_a_machine_posts_the_full_diameter_depth` fails (the machine golden is stale). This was the gap of earlier finding 2. It is now closed.
- `Z-12.803` changed to `Z-11.` in `mazak/drill_full_diameter.nc`: `script_mazak::drill_full_diameter` and `recorded_streams::each_drilling_post_records_the_full_diameter_depth` both fail.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/heidenhain-klartext/drill_full_diameter_on_machine.refusal` has no reader. No test calls `check_on_machine` for Klartext, and no guard finds an unread golden. Thus the file can go stale without a red test. Add the call in `script_heidenhain_klartext`, or drop the file and let #4461 record the gap.

The PR waits for a merge of main and the two fixes above. Then it needs a fresh review of the new head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
